findings: The BigInt rational implementation matches floor((point*dpi/72 - deviceOrigin) + 0.5), with negative ties following floor(x + 0.5), not rounding away from zero.
Origin subtraction occurs before rounding. Safe-integer origin and output guards, positive-DPI validation, and finite-number checks are present.

Focused tests cover the recorded DMG p.19 half-pixel boundary, near-ties on both signs, positive and negative origins, negative ties, and exponent-form values. Candidate logs record 16/16 module tests and a valid current report.

The public build API derives the trusted snapshot from its pinned repository pointer; caller-supplied snapshot mutations are rejected instead of being used to reach malformed-origin or DPI branches. No meaningful conversion or guard regression found.

finding.cause: The new Caltrop current-checkpoint branch calls bytes(), which delegates to readBeforeJoFile(). That facade intentionally returns the frozen pre-Jo projection for the Caltrop catalog, but the branch compares it to the post-Jo extension.after.sha256.
finding.repairDirection: Read raw current catalog bytes from the test root for the post-Jo hash assertion; retain the frozen gzip fixture and its uncompressed hash for the pre-Jo checkpoint returned to the historical comparison. Preserve all V2 and inherited negative controls.
